title: Tactile switch 6×6
summary: A 6 × 6 push switch on its side, stem out through a plain round hole in the box wall. Set it on its seat, push it forward, and two flexing cheeks snap their teeth in behind it. The teeth take the press.

views.label: How it goes in
views.caption: Drag the slider to push the switch from its seat into the hole: the cheeks spread, then the teeth snap in behind the body. Section cuts in from the side, through a cheek and its tooth.

views.label: Fit piece
views.caption: Four holders on one strip of 2.4 wall, marked with 1 to 4 engraved dots: three tooth depths, and a tighter fit round the body.

specs.title: The switch
rows: Back of body to stem tip
specs.note: Fit it with the legs to the sides: they slide along grooves in the cheeks, above and below the teeth.

specs.title: Sizes (BOJACK kit)
specs.note: Pick a switch by name; tact6x6Standoff(name, wall, proud) sets it back from the wall so the stem stands the same distance proud whatever its length.
specs.badgeNote: only the low-profile one is measured

specs.title: The holder
rows: Teeth reach in behind the body
specs.badgeNote: the tooth depth is set by the fit piece

checks: Push it in: does it click?
Does it sit without rattling, stem centred in the hole?
Does a press click cleanly, without the switch moving back?
Can you pull it back out without breaking a cheek?
fit.print: Print base down, no supports, PETG.
